data.title: Projektmanager Instandhaltung und Sanierung (m/w/d)
data.description:
Sie kommen vom Bau oder aus dem Handwerk, erkennen auf den ersten Blick, ob eine Arbeit sauber ausgeführt ist, und wollen Maßnahmen nicht mehr selbst ausführen, sondern voranbringen? Dann sind Sie bei uns richtig.

Die Immobetriebe Hausverwaltung GmbH ist ein inhabergeführtes Unternehmen in Konstanz. Wir verwalten Wohnungseigentümergemeinschaften, Mietshäuser und größere Gewerbeobjekte im Raum Konstanz, Radolfzell und Singen. Wir arbeiten weitgehend digital: ein Vorgangssystem für alle Fälle, KI-Assistenz bei Routinen und Abläufe, die wir aufschreiben und gemeinsam verbessern.

Bisher haben unsere Verwalter die Umsetzung von Instandhaltung und Sanierung neben ihren rechtlichen Aufgaben mitgetragen. Diese Aufgabe lösen wir jetzt heraus und machen sie zu einer eigenen Stelle, die eng mit den Verwaltern zusammenarbeitet: Die Verwaltung führt Versammlung und Beschluss, Sie bringen die beschlossenen Maßnahmen auf die Baustelle und zum Abschluss.

Als Projektkoordinator sorgen Sie dafür, dass Instandhaltung und Sanierung in unseren Objekten zügig, in guter Qualität und im beschlossenen Budget umgesetzt werden. Die Ausführung liegt bei unseren Fachfirmen. Sie vertreten die Eigentümer als Bauherr: Sie planen, beauftragen, prüfen und halten nach, bis die Maßnahme abgenommen ist.

Aufgaben

  • Sie sehen sich Schäden und Instandhaltungsbedarf vor Ort an und schätzen ein, was zu tun ist und welche Gewerke gebraucht werden

  • Sie besprechen Umbau- und Modernisierungswünsche von Eigentümern am Objekt und machen daraus ein umsetzbares Vorhaben

  • Sie holen Angebote ein, vergleichen sie und bereiten Entscheidungen vor; Umfang, Varianten und Kosten liefern Sie für die Beschlüsse der Eigentümer, den Beschluss selbst holt die Verwaltung ein

  • Steht der Beschluss, setzen Sie die Maßnahme um: Sie beauftragen die Firmen, setzen Termine, koordinieren die Gewerke und halten nach, bis alles erledigt ist

  • Sie prüfen vor Ort, ob fachgerecht gearbeitet wird, nehmen Leistungen ab, verfolgen Mängel und prüfen Rechnungen gegen den Auftrag

  • Sie arbeiten im Rahmen der Budgets und Freigaben, die Beschlüsse und Verwaltervertrag vorgeben, und melden Abweichungen frühzeitig

  • Sie dokumentieren jedes Projekt im Vorgangssystem und erfassen Ihre Zeiten laufend

  • Ein großer Teil Ihrer Arbeit findet am Schreibtisch statt: Telefon, E-Mail, Angebote und Abstimmung mit Eigentümern, Beirat und Verwaltung

Qualifikation

  • Eine bautechnische Ausbildung, etwa im Handwerk, als Techniker oder ein Studium im Bauwesen, und mehrjährige Praxis am Bau oder in der Instandhaltung von Gebäuden

  • Ein gutes Auge für Qualität über mehrere Gewerke hinweg; Sie erkennen, was ein Schaden braucht und was ein Angebot taugt

  • Freude daran, Dinge zu Ende zu bringen und mehrere Maßnahmen gleichzeitig im Blick zu behalten

  • Verlässlichkeit im Umgang mit Budgets und Freigaben

  • Sorgfalt in der Dokumentation: Projektstand und Zeiten schreiben Sie konsequent auf

  • Ein freundliches, klares Auftreten gegenüber Eigentümern und Handwerkern

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Microsoft 365; Offenheit für digitale Werkzeuge und KI im Alltag

  • Führerschein Klasse B und verhandlungssicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift

  • WEG-Recht müssen Sie nicht mitbringen. Die rechtliche Seite verantwortet die Verwaltung, Sie lernen sie im Alltag kennen

Benefits

  • Direkteinstieg in bestehende Projekte mit beschlossenen Maßnahmen, mit sauberer Übergabe durch die betreuenden Verwalter

  • Eigene Projekte von der Besichtigung bis zur Abnahme, mit klaren Vorgaben und Rückhalt im Team

  • Abwechslung zwischen Büro und Objekten in der Region, planbare Arbeitszeiten statt Baustellenalltag

  • Dienstfahrzeuge für Fahrten zu den Objekten

  • Ein Jahresgehalt, das zu Ihrer Erfahrung passt

  • Ein unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis in einem Unternehmen, das seine Arbeitsweise gerade grundlegend modernisiert

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und eine Geschäftsführung, die offen für aktive Mitgestaltung ist

  • Einen Arbeitsplatz mit KI-Assistenz, die Angebote, Unterlagen und Routinen vorbereitet

  • Zentrale Lage in Konstanz mit guter Verkehrsanbindung und kostenfreien Parkplätzen

  • Betriebliche Zusatzleistungen und Weiterbildung

Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt? Dann bewerben Sie sich bei uns.

Wenn Sie Maßnahmen gern in die Hand nehmen und zu Ende bringen, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf, frühestmöglichem Eintrittstermin und Gehaltsvorstellung.

Bewerbungskosten, etwa Fahrtkosten zu Vorstellungsgesprächen, können wir leider nicht übernehmen.

data.title: Solutions Engineer UAS / Aviation
Senior Product Manager, AI Products & Agentic Hospitality (f/m/d)
data.description:
About the role 

 

At Apaleo, we're building the open, API-first property management platform for hospitality. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, and the first AI agent marketplace for hospitality in our Agent Hub, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers. 

We're looking for a senior Product Manager to ownin our AI product domain. You'll turn our AI capabilities into coherent, commercially viable products that solve real operational problems for hoteliers. Your goal is to help hotels move towards genuinely autonomous operations, not to ship isolated automations or AI assistants. 

This is not a backlog role. You'll take an ambiguous opportunity, find the right customer problems, define the proposition, build it with Engineering, bring it to market and drive adoption. You'll also play a central role in turning our AI capabilities into a meaningful and growing source of revenue. 

This is a senior individual contributor role with real autonomy. You won't receive a roadmap and execute it. You'll shape it along our vision, using customer insight, data and sound reasoning. You'll work closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing and Customer Success, and in close collaboration with our other value stream teams.  

 

What you'll be up to 

  • Productising and commercialising our AI capabilities. Define the proposition, target customers and use cases, and shape packaging and launch with commercial teams. 
  • Building the foundations for AI across our ecosystem. Shape how our AI capabilities understand each hotel's context and work reliably with Apaleo and connected systems across operational areas. 
  • Productising hospitality knowledge. Turn hospitality expertise and operational processes into scalable product experiences, with appropriate human oversight. 
  • Driving autonomy and measurable value. Think in complete outcomes, such as staff hours saved and manual work removed. Show hoteliers tangible ROI. 
  • Driving adoption. Run discovery, shape onboarding and usability, measure adoption and improve from real-world feedback. 
  • Keeping AI products reliable and viable. Define good agent performance, understand cost and latency, set up evaluation and monitoring with Engineering, and trade off autonomy, reliability, human intervention and cost. 
  • Owning strategy, roadmap and delivery in your scope, with clear specs, a definition of done and impact analysis. 
  • Working with Engineering on trade-offs, dependencies, quality and our API-first AI-first architecture. 
  • Balancing ambition with reality. Weigh the roadmap against operational requests, bugs and technical debt, and say no to good ideas that aren't great ones. 
  • Spotting dependencies early with Hotel Operations and other engineering teams, since our AI capabilities build on the core platform. 
  • Using AI in your own PM work and championing AI-assisted engineering.  

 

What you'll bring 

  • 6+ years as a Product Manager, owning products from discovery through launch and adoption with limited day-to-day direction. 
  • Proven zero-to-one experience. You've taken a new B2B product, not a feature, from an ambiguous problem to paying customers, driving discovery, validation, definition, prioritisation and launch. 
  • Ownership after launch. You've owned a revenue, adoption or retention number and can tell us what moved and what you killed, pivoted or repriced. 
  • Commercial thinking. You've defined propositions, packaging and pricing, validated willingness to pay and worked with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success on go-to-market. 
  • Systems and process thinking. You break processes into steps, decisions and handoffs, and understand how systems with different data models and sources of truth affect the reliability of agents. 
  • Meaningful AI product experience. You've built and launched AI-powered products or capabilities used by real customers, understand what makes a product agentic, and can discuss context, tools, latency, cost and evaluation, with a view on human-in-the-loop design. 
  • Customer centricity and product judgement. You turn interview patterns into opportunities, make tough trade-offs and prioritise ruthlessly. 
  • Platform thinking. You weigh customer needs against reusable capabilities, API consistency and long-term platform evolution. 
  • Stakeholder alignment. You align Engineering, commercial teams and peers, manage cross-team dependencies and communicate trade-offs with confidence. 
  • Autonomy and adaptability. You take ownership, raise risks early and make progress through ambiguity. 

 

Strongly preferred 

  • Agentic AI products in production. You've taken an agentic AI product beyond prototype to paying customers, and dealt with reliability, permissions, exceptions, human intervention and evaluation. This is different from AI-powered features such as chatbots, summarisation or copilots. 

 

Nice to have 

  • Hospitality technology or hotel operations experience. 
  • Experience with PMS, RMS, CRS, channel managers, OTAs or hospitality distribution. 
  • Experience in B2B SaaS platforms, ecosystems or integration-heavy products. 
  • Experience with AI governance, permissions, identity, orchestration or enterprise AI adoption. 
  • Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up. 
  • Comfort with AI-assisted engineering processes. 

 

Don't tick every box? Hospitality experience is an advantage, not a prerequisite. A strong zero-to-one B2B product builder from another domain, with real AI product experience and a commercial mindset, can be a better fit than a hospitality specialist without them. We'd still love to hear from you. 

 

Who you are 

  • You take high ownership. You answer for product outcomes, not just delivery commitments. 
  • You're strategic and hands-on. You can set a product vision and still get into customer discovery, operational processes and detailed product decisions. 
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. You make progress when the problem or the solution isn't fully defined. 
  • You think commercially. You ask what customers will buy and why, not just what Engineering can build. 
  • You're customer obsessed. You understand real operational pain and test your assumptions with customers. 
  • You're technically curious. You know enough about AI and agentic systems to hold meaningful discussions with engineers and make informed product decisions. 
  • You measure what matters. You judge success by customer outcomes, adoption and commercial impact, not features shipped. 

 

What we offer 

Culture and growth 

  • A diverse and international team. Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique perspectives and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech. 
  • Growth and development. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility. 
  • Autonomy and ownership. Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly, in an environment built on trust and transparency. 
  • Competitive and fair compensation. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. 

 

Perks and lifestyle 

  • Flexible and remote work options. We focus on results, not clocking hours. Work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup. 
  • Free public transport. Travel across Germany with a fully covered Deutschland Ticket. 
  • Paid time off. 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired. 
  • Health and wellbeing. Access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership. 

 

Joining Apaleo 

How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo is more than taking on a role. It's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. 

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

data.title: Solutions Engineer
data.description:
About the Role

Join a team bringing digital tools to industrial research and development. You will lead technical pre-sales engagements, helping prospective customers understand how modern data management can support their R&D workflows and accelerate innovation.

What You'll Do

  • Own the technical pre-sales process from initial demonstrations through value cases, technical evaluations, and pilot execution.

  • Build tailored demonstrations, workshops, and pilots for prospective customers' research and development workflows.

  • Partner with sales colleagues and customer stakeholders to communicate business value and support new customer acquisition.

  • Lead technical evaluations and presentations that explain how digital R&D data tools support research and innovation.

  • Mentor team members supporting technical evaluations.

  • Write scripts and configure platform integrations for customer engagements as needed.

  • Travel 25% to 50% for customer meetings, presentations, and workshops.

What We're Looking For

  • Four to seven years of relevant experience, including at least four years in digitalization, change management, or R&D leadership.

  • An advanced degree in chemistry, chemical engineering, or materials science, ideally with a machine learning or computational focus.

  • Strong chemistry or materials science knowledge and experience with industrial R&D workflows and laboratory informatics systems.

  • Experience building and demonstrating technical platforms for enterprise customers, with a value-based selling approach.

  • Experience in digital transformation or change management; R&D leadership in the chemicals or materials sector is valuable.

  • Python scripting skills are a plus.

  • Willingness and ability to travel 25% to 50%, and authorization to work in the US, UK, or Germany. Visa sponsorship is not available.

  • For the Munich location, professional fluency in the relevant local language and fluent English are expected.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary: $120,000 to $150,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.

Location

Hybrid role based in Munich, Bavaria, Germany. London or New York may also be possible.

Compensation: $120K – $150K

data.title: Senior Legal Partner
data.description:
About the Role

A Germany-based, AI-enabled legal services firm is seeking a senior partner to help grow its practice and shape how technology supports legal work. You will bring an established client portfolio, continue advising those clients, and work with the founding team to develop a scalable model for commercial and compliance services.

What You'll Do

  • Help shape the firm's growth and expand its client relationships.

  • Bring a portable client portfolio to the firm's technology platform while continuing to serve existing clients.

  • Build market credibility and develop opportunities through your professional network, including private equity and venture capital contacts.

  • Identify opportunities to provide commercial and compliance services across your client base.

  • Work with the founding team to identify recurring legal matters that can be streamlined through AI and automation.

What We're Looking For

  • 12 to 20 or more years of German legal practice, with experience at partner level.

  • German-qualified Volljurist and admitted Rechtsanwalt, with native-level German and professional English.

  • A personally held, portable book of business valued at €1 million or more, with a diversified client base and strong private equity or venture capital relationships.

  • Experience in recurring, automatable work such as commercial contracts, IT and data, corporate or venture capital, or regulatory matters.

  • Practical experience using AI tools, such as OpenAI-based tools, and a willingness to adapt legal workflows through automation.

  • A realistic client transition path and no restrictions that would prevent bringing client relationships to a new practice.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary range: €200,000 to €300,000 annually. Meaningful equity is available. Visa sponsorship is not available.

Location

Based in Berlin, Germany. The role is primarily remote, with in-person work in Berlin preferred; remote arrangements are considered for exceptional candidates.

Compensation: €200K – €300K
